steps.text: The microwave keypad is visible high on the right side of the range hood; the likely start control is the lower right of its two colored buttons. Its camera calibrated position is about half a meter from the current hand, so I’m going to estimate small joint-to-hand motions from the exposed proprio readings before moving toward it. I’ll approach in short steps and recheck the camera image along the way.

"""Vision and proprioception controller for the live RoboCasa365 episode."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json, pathlib, sys, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
CAM = 'robot0_agentview_center'

def connect():
    global r, spec, names, lo, hi
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    names = list(spec['cameras'])
    lo = np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['lower'], dtype=float)
    hi = np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['upper'], dtype=float)
    print('Connected:', spec['task_text'], 'budget:', spec['budget'])
    print('status:', r.status())
    return r

def observe(cameras=None, depth=True, save='latest'):
    if cameras is None: cameras = [CAM, 'robot0_agentview_right', 'robot0_eye_in_hand']
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
    if save:
        d = OUT / save; d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (d/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
        for c, im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(d/f'{c}.png')
        for c, dep in o.depth.items(): np.save(d/f'depth_{c}.npy', dep)
    return o

def state(o=None):
    if o is None: o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
    layout, now = o.meta['proprio']['layout'], np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    ix = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(layout)}
    q = np.array([now[ix[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos']] for i in range(1,8)])
    xyz = np.array([now[ix[f'eef_right_{c}']] for c in 'xyz'])
    return q, xyz, now, ix

def action(q, grip=-1., base=(0.,0.,0.), torso=0., mode=-1.):
    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=float)
    a[:7] = q; a[7] = grip; a[8:11] = base; a[11] = torso; a[12] = mode
    return a

def send(q, steps=5, grip=-1., base=(0.,0.,0.), torso=0., mode=-1., note=''):
    A = np.tile(action(q,grip,base,torso,mode), (int(steps),1))
    return r.submit('joint_position', A, interpolate='hold', cameras=[CAM], video='none', note=note)

def pixel_world(o, cam, u, v, radius=2):
    """Back-project a depth patch using this response's camera calibration (OpenGL camera axes)."""
    d = np.asarray(o.depth[cam])
    if d.ndim == 3: d = d[-1]
    patch = d[max(0,int(v-radius)):int(v+radius+1), max(0,int(u-radius)):int(u+radius+1)]
    z = patch[np.isfinite(patch) & (patch > 0)]
    if not len(z): raise ValueError('no valid depth at pixel')
    dist = float(np.median(z))
    cal = o.meta['cameras'][cam]
    K = np.asarray(cal['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cal['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
    # OpenCV pixel ray is +z; OpenGL camera looks along -z.
    cv = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*dist/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*dist/K[1,1], -dist, 1.])
    return (T @ cv)[:3], dist

if __name__ == '__main__':
    connect()
    obs = observe()
    q0, xyz0, now0, ix0 = state(obs)
    print('q0=', np.round(q0,5), 'eef=', np.round(xyz0,5))
    print('time_left_s=', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))

"""Self-authored visual/proprioception controller for TurnOnMicrowave.

The controller uses only RGB/depth camera responses, their per-response
calibration, and robot proprioception. It never reads object poses or simulator
state. This is the procedure used for the single live episode; do not run it
again against that episode after it has been completed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
CENTER = 'robot0_agentview_center'
RIGHT = 'robot0_agentview_right'
EYE = 'robot0_eye_in_hand'
CAMERAS = [CENTER, 'robot0_agentview_left', RIGHT, EYE]

# Pixels visually identified in the live camera frames: initial center view of
# the lower-right keypad button, then a close eye-in-hand view of that same
# button. They are image coordinates, not simulator object coordinates.
INITIAL_BUTTON_PIXEL = (290, 39)
CLOSE_BUTTON_PIXEL = (146, 108)


def connect():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    if spec.get('task_text') != 'Press the start button on the microwave.':
        raise RuntimeError('unexpected task')
    print('connected; wall-clock budget:', spec['budget'].get('wall_clock_s'))
    return robot, spec


def capture(robot, cameras, name, depth=True):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
    if name:
        folder = OUT / name
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (folder / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
        for cam, rgb in obs.last.items():
            Image.fromarray(rgb).save(folder / f'{cam}.png')
        for cam, arr in obs.depth.items():
            np.save(folder / f'depth_{cam}.npy', arr)
    return obs


def state_from_obs(obs):
    layout = obs.meta['proprio']['layout']
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    ix = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(layout)}
    q = np.array([now[ix[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos']] for i in range(1, 8)])
    xyz = np.array([now[ix[f'eef_right_{axis}']] for axis in 'xyz'])
    return q, xyz


def state_from_submit(res):
    p = np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    # Current eai-standard/2.1 layout: seven arm joint positions at 4:11,
    # end-effector xyz at 26:29.
    return p[4:11].copy(), p[26:29].copy()


def make_action(q, grip=-1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0, mode=-1.0):
    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=float)
    a[:7] = q
    a[7] = grip
    a[8:11] = base
    a[11] = torso
    a[12] = mode
    return a


def pixel_world(obs, camera, u, v, radius=1):
    """Back-project a depth patch using this response's OpenGL camera pose."""
    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[camera])
    if d.ndim == 3:
        d = d[-1]
    u, v = int(round(u)), int(round(v))
    patch = d[max(0, v-radius):v+radius+1, max(0, u-radius):u+radius+1]
    valid = patch[np.isfinite(patch) & (patch > 0)]
    if not len(valid):
        raise ValueError(f'no valid depth at {camera} pixel {(u, v)}')
    z = float(np.median(valid))
    cal = obs.meta['cameras'][camera]
    K = np.asarray(cal['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cal['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
    # Convert the +z-forward OpenCV ray to the -z-forward OpenGL camera frame.
    p_cam_gl = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0],
                         -(v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], -z, 1.0])
    return (T @ p_cam_gl)[:3]


def read_state(robot):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video='none')
    return state_from_obs(obs)


def probe_jacobian(robot, q0, xyz0, eps=0.025, hold_steps=6):
    """Estimate local xyz-per-joint motion from small commanded perturbations."""
    rows = []
    for j in range(7):
        q = q0.copy()
        q[j] += eps
        rows.extend([make_action(q)] * hold_steps)
        rows.extend([make_action(q0)] * hold_steps)
    res = robot.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows), interpolate='hold',
                       cameras=[], video='none', video_fps=20,
                       note='small proprio-only perturbations for local Jacobian')
    p = np.asarray(res.proprio, dtype=float)
    X = p[:, 4:11] - q0
    Y = p[:, 26:29] - xyz0
    fit = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[X, np.ones(len(X))], Y, rcond=None)[0]
    return fit[:7].T


def cartesian_step(robot, q, xyz, goal, J, max_step=0.07,
                   damping=0.025, max_joint_step=0.22, steps=18, note='Cartesian approach'):
    """Move one short Cartesian increment using a damped local Jacobian inverse."""
    delta = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float) - xyz
    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(delta))
    if distance < 1e-8:
        return q, xyz, None
    step = delta * min(1.0, max_step / distance)
    dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + damping*damping*np.eye(3), step)
    largest = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
    if largest > max_joint_step:
        dq *= max_joint_step / largest
    cmd = q + dq
    res = robot.submit('joint_position',
                       np.tile(make_action(cmd), (steps, 1)),
                       interpolate='hold', cameras=[CENTER, RIGHT], video='none',
                       note=note)
    q_next, xyz_next = state_from_submit(res)
    return q_next, xyz_next, res


def press_and_retreat(robot):
    """Visual approach, brief close at the button, then withdraw and stop."""
    obs = capture(robot, CAMERAS, 'run_initial')
    q, xyz = state_from_obs(obs)
    button = pixel_world(obs, CENTER, *INITIAL_BUTTON_PIXEL, radius=1)

    # The keypad face is vertical and its visible normal is approximately the
    # world x axis in this frozen instance. Stage the grip site 9 cm in front.
    staging = button + np.array([-0.09, 0.0, 0.0])
    J = probe_jacobian(robot, q, xyz, eps=0.04, hold_steps=6)
    history = [(q.copy(), xyz.copy())]
    step_index = 0
    while np.linalg.norm(staging - xyz) > 0.02 and step_index < 12:
        q, xyz, _ = cartesian_step(robot, q, xyz, staging, J,
                                   max_step=0.075, steps=18,
                                   note=f'Cartesian staging step {step_index+1}')
        history.append((q.copy(), xyz.copy()))
        step_index += 1
        # Refresh the measured Jacobian periodically as the arm changes posture.
        if step_index in (2, 4):
            J = probe_jacobian(robot, q, xyz, eps=0.025, hold_steps=6)

    # Re-localize the same lower-right colored button in the close eye camera.
    eye_obs = capture(robot, [EYE], 'run_close_view')
    button = pixel_world(eye_obs, EYE, *CLOSE_BUTTON_PIXEL, radius=1)
    q, xyz = read_state(robot)
    # Keep a measured pose known to be well clear of the button for the final
    # retreat. The latest earlier pose with >22 cm clearance was used live.
    clear = [(q_i, x_i) for q_i, x_i in history
             if np.linalg.norm(button - x_i) > 0.22]
    retreat_q = clear[-1][0] if clear else history[0][0]

    J = probe_jacobian(robot, q, xyz, eps=0.018, hold_steps=5)
    # Advance in short increments. If geometry prevents further hand motion,
    # closing the fingers at the measured position still makes a controlled
    # contact attempt.
    for n, step_size in enumerate((0.055, 0.045)):
        before = xyz.copy()
        goal = button
        q, xyz, _ = cartesian_step(robot, q, xyz, goal, J,
                                   max_step=step_size, steps=18,
                                   note=f'button approach step {n+1}')
        if n == 0:
            J = probe_jacobian(robot, q, xyz, eps=0.015, hold_steps=6)
        if n == 1 and np.linalg.norm(xyz - before) < 0.015:
            break

    # Brief close at the visually localized button. No success flag is queried.
    close = robot.submit('joint_position',
                         np.tile(make_action(q, grip=1.0), (12, 1)),
                         interpolate='hold', cameras=[CENTER, RIGHT, EYE],
                         video='none', note='brief gripper close at start button')
    q, xyz = state_from_submit(close)

    # Opening and withdrawing far enough makes the final scored configuration
    # safe. Do not submit any further controls after this retreat.
    retreat = robot.submit('joint_position',
                           np.tile(make_action(retreat_q, grip=-1.0), (20, 1)),
                           interpolate='linear', cameras=CAMERAS, video='none',
                           include_depth=True,
                           note='open and withdraw to measured clear pose')
    q_final, xyz_final = state_from_submit(retreat)
    print('final eef:', xyz_final,
          'distance from visually localized button:',
          float(np.linalg.norm(button - xyz_final)))
    retreat.save(str(OUT / 'final_observation'))
    return retreat


if __name__ == '__main__':
    robot, _ = connect()
    press_and_retreat(robot)
